package fixture

import (
	"context"
	"os/exec"
	"testing"
)

// The constructors are taken as function values and called through variables.
func TestConstructorValue(t *testing.T) {
	start := exec.Command
	startCtx := exec.CommandContext
	_ = start("luau", "-v").Run()
	_ = startCtx(context.Background(), "luau", "-v").Run()
}
